question: With which of the following Indian states is the folk dance Lezim associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lezim**

 
 
• **​**The **Indian state **is the Lezim folk dance associated with **Maharashtra**.
 
• **Lezim** dancers use a small **musical **instrument with jingling **cymbals **called the **Lezim **or **lezium**, after which the dance style is named, which is often also spelt as** "Lezium."**
 
• In a **lezim**, there are at least **20 **dancers. The wooden idiophone to which tiny metal discs have been affixed and which the dancers utilise while performing the classical dance is the source of the name of this dance.
 
• The primary percussion music is played on the drum instrument **dholki**.
 
• It is performed while wearing vibrant **outfits**. With the dance's numerous callisthenic motions and potential for physical exertion, **Maharashtra schools**, **militias**, and other organisations regularly use it as a **fitness exercise**.
